name: BACH_0346
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (97%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Normal only; invasive risk is 1% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Normal 97%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 1% | Strongly favors Normal |
| Conformal set | Normal only (90% level) | Single class, no ambiguity |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | No quality flag [F6] |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes, same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 Normal | Mostly agree [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 1, 5, 11) · ↓ invasive · Linked to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 6, 9, 10) · ↓ invasive · Largest negative term; 0/20 spot check [F2] · Unreliable
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 0) · context · Below typical here; 8/20 spot check [F3] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top 3 regions beats random (logit drop 0.54, CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion difference 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0; not shown to reflect classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Too few tumor nuclei in sampled regions; cell analysis gives no check.
- OOD percentile is 94; stain or focus issues could mislead despite no flag.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 7, 0** — older per-region probe gives 89%, 69%, 51% invasive; confirm benign.
2. **Regions 6, 9, 10** — confirm normal lobules with two-layered epithelium; concept spot check failed.
3. **Regions 5, 11** — only small positive heatmap contributions; check for stromal invasion.
